## Development Environment

For detailed setup and development instructions, please refer to our [Development Guide](../docs/how-to-develop.md).

## User Interaction

- The staff is not technical. Explain in simple terms and avoid jargon.
- Keep instructions easy to understand for non-programmers.
- Any code changes must be simple and maintainable.

## Program Architecture

- Website users are students and teachers.
- Keep UI simple and clean.
- Do not create extra apps or services.
- Do not create CLI tools.
- Do not make one huge file — keep structure organized.
- Only use HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python.
